createOrReplace.title: Admission Requirements Engineering (RIT Dubai, PDF)
createOrReplace.excerpt: Engineering: Must cover Math preferably pre-calculus at secondary school (minimum grade 80% or equivalent); two sciences: physics and chemistry or biology (minimum 80%). UAE: Elite 75%, Advanced 80%, Applied/General 85%. American/SABIS/Canadian: Minimum 80%, SAT 1 Math of 450 (SAT not required for Canadian). British: Minimum 5 IGCSE (C or above) and 2 As or 1 A level (D or above); Math, Physics and 1 of Chemistry/Biology minimum C in IGCSE or AS/A Level; Completion of Grade 12/Year 13; Minimum average 80%. IB: Minimum 28 points; Math, Physics and 1 of Chemistry/Biology minimum 4.

Maths, Physics, and Chemistry or Biology at C or above (IGCSE or AS/A-Level). English: IELTS Academic 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 79 / EmSAT English 1550 for full admission (IELTS 5.0-6.0 / TOEFL 61-78 gives conditional admission); students from English-medium curricula may be exempt.

IB: at least 28 points, with 4 or above in Maths, Physics, and Chemistry or Biology. English: IELTS Academic 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 79 / EmSAT English 1550 for full admission (IELTS 5.0-6.0 / TOEFL 61-78 gives conditional admission); students from English-medium curricula may be exempt.

UAE curriculum: 75% (Elite), 80% (Advanced) or 85% (Applied/General), with Maths (preferably pre-calculus) and two sciences, Physics plus Chemistry or Biology, at 80% or equivalent. American/SABIS/Canadian: at least 80%, plus SAT Math 450 (SAT not needed for the Canadian curriculum), with Maths (preferably pre-calculus) and Physics plus Chemistry or Biology at 80%. English: IELTS Academic 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 79 / EmSAT English 1550 for full admission (IELTS 5.0-6.0 / TOEFL 61-78 gives conditional admission); students from English-medium curricula may be exempt.
